sentences.en: The road goes from the town to the sea.
sentences.zh: 这条路从城镇通向大海。

sentences.en: The path through the trees is narrow.
This street is long and straight.
The stone on the path is rough.
The sand on the beach is soft.
The dust on the road is dry.
The river goes through the valley.
We see the mountain from the road.
The sign on the street says 'Stop'.
The path is at the side of the river.
